offers_products.reason: Makes Simpson Strong-Tie structural connectors, anchors, fasteners and fastening systems for wood and concrete construction.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from building products; engineering support and training are incidental to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells through home centers to DIY homeowners and deck builders, though mainly to professionals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to lumber dealers, distributors, home centers, contractors and homebuilders who buy for resale or construction.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of connectors and fasteners by dealers, distributors and builders; consumable construction components, not one-off projects.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand follows housing starts and new construction, which can be postponed in downturns, despite some repair and retrofit work.

big_ticket.reason: Connectors, anchors and fasteners are low-priced items bought frequently in volume.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured building products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are many dealers, distributors, contractors and homebuilders, plus big home center chains, a mixed base.

asset_heavy.reason: Steel product manufacturing needs plants and equipment, but it is moderate compared with heavy industry; mostly fabrication and assembly.

notes: Asset intensity and customer size are judgment calls.
